Definition: probably for G1216; Demas, a Christian:--Demas.
BiblicalUsage: Demas is the fellow labourer who loved this present world and forsook Paul in his last imprisonment. He is named with Luke and Mark in the letters of the earlier years, and in the last letter he is gone. The contrast is the warning: the faithful remain, and the one who loved the world departs.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Demas is the saddest name in the letters: a man who worked beside Paul and left him, because the present world seemed better than the coming one. I hold that his story is written so that we will not follow it.
